title: US Economic Notes - What you need to know for the week ahead

classification.rationale: The weekly note frames upcoming CPI and PPI prints as the determinant of whether the Fed hikes at the September 16 FOMC, with labour market and inflation forecasts as supporting evidence.
classification.runner_up_reason: Much of the text is detailed August CPI/PPI component forecasts, but the argument is ultimately about the Fed's September decision.
